hypothesis: For z_n = x^(2^n) over Mul={x,×} and Sq={x,×,sq} with sq definable, expressivity is shared, tree size drops from 2^{n+1}-1 to n+1, circuit size is n in both bases, and Gibbs fiber mass under π(t)∝4^{-|t|} satisfies the amended shortest-witness bound, with a single Catalan shell of 9694845 versus 27 Sq shells at n=4.

controls.description: Independent DP of Mul-trees must match C_{2^n-1} on the unique size shell 2^{n+1}-1.
Occupied Sq sizes must be exactly {n+1,...,2^{n+1}-1}, not a sparse subset that could fake a mass gap.
The 2^k degree cap is checked on repeated squaring and on left-associated and self-mul circuits.
The fiber-mass gate uses Φ/Z, not raw Φ. The run-1 unnormalised bound is recorded and is not the criterion.

gates.criterion: Every degree in 1..16 is realised by at least one Mul-tree and one Sq-tree.
For each n in {1,2,3,4}, Mul size is 2^{n+1}-1 and the Sq-tower size is n+1.
The Mul fiber of degree 2^n is exactly C_{2^n-1} trees on a single size shell.
Repeated squaring reaches degree 2^n in n steps; max degree after k steps is ≤ 2^k on the tower and two alternative circuits.
For every registered n, log2(P_Sq/P_Mul) is at least the amended shortest-witness bound; at n=4 the ratio is at least 28.28.
The Sq fiber occupies every size from n+1 through 2^{n+1}-1 (27 shells at n=4).
